**Co-promotion pattern step + micro-finding queue: pre-push hook diffs against main not the tracker (baptism-#2 class, now local)**

Two findings from the convention co-promotion (#262, MERGED).

**(1) Co-promotion pattern — explicit step: an APPROVED mother issue that covers the promotion.** The #262 promotion branch was born without an issue and `issue-link` blocked it first; a mother issue had to be created + approved to unblock. So the #255/#216 co-promotion pattern is: (a) create + get-approved a covering issue, (b) agent prepares the COMPLETE promotion branch (all edits applied, chain-guard green), pushed NOT opened, (c) human opens + merges with zero manual edits. Step (a) is not optional — issue-link enforces it. Add it to the pattern. Related: [[doctrine/conventions-land-in-canonical-docs]].

**(2) MICRO-FINDING (queued, do NOT fix now — owner ruled): the local pre-push hook diffs against `main` instead of the tracker branch.** On the #262 push it warned "~6097 changed lines" — a false alarm; the real diff vs the branch's parent (`feature/v2.0.0`) was 2 files/16 lines. This is the SAME class as baptism finding #2 (base-branch confusion), now surfaced in the LOCAL pre-push hook rather than a PR base. Fix direction (later): the hook should diff against the branch's actual upstream/tracker, not hardcode `main`. Queue it; the owner explicitly said not to fix it during the E1/D2 work.
